## About
Mr Lucky's Billiards is one of the oldest pool rooms in Los Angeles, and we have a generational following. We aspire to create a friendly place for all.
If you're looking for a place to hang out, cool down with a beer or shoot a game of pool, this is the spot. Our tables are kept dead straight and felted with wool Simonis cloth, and the beer is kept cold and frosty.
We're rated 4.5 on Google from 384 reviews. Come by and say hello.

## Services
- Brunswick Gold Crowns: Play on Brunswick Gold Crowns, considered the best regulation table at pro events.
- Beer on tap: A 24 tap draft system with local and classic beers.
- Weekly leagues: Join our weekly BCA sponsored leagues.
- Snacks and non-alcoholic beverages: We carry a selection of snacks and non-alcoholic beverages.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We open every day at noon and stay open late, a little later on Friday and Saturday nights.

Q: Can I bring food?
A: Yes, you can have food delivered, and Domino's is right next door. Please don't bring outside beverages.

Q: How do you charge for tables?
A: One reviewer explained that you pay for the table by the hour.

Q: What if all the tables are taken?
A: A reviewer said you can put your name on the list and hang out until a table opens up.

## What customers say
- "Love this place! Close to home, great date spot! They do have beer and ciders on tap, there are several tables, and if you don't mind waiting if it's busy you can just put your name on the list and hang out with your friend or date. We went for a date night, and even ordered food from Domino's and ate outside and went back in, only to see the others actually brought their food into the establishment. They played an eclectic playlist that I actually liked, it was loud enough to hear, but I also could easily hear my partner when we were talking. You pay for the table by the hour, and it was a really good experience for us! Parking was free, easy, and plenty." (Sabrina Keigley, 5/5)
- "One of the best pool halls I've been to.
Easy to find location with plenty of free self parking.
Clean and very well kept. The tables are in excellent shape.
Very friendly staff.
Went there on a Saturday afternoon. Although all the tables were in use, it took about 30 min for one to open up.
The tables are spread apart well and has plenty of room to walk around the tables.
Other players there seemed friendly.
Didn't sense any hostility or intimidation.
Good music playing.
They only serve drinks.
There's a Domino's pizza next door if you're hungry.
We played for about 3 hours. I think it's $8/Hr before 7pm

Love this place!
Will definitely be going back." (Sam Hosein, 5/5)
